preserved_failures.outcome: Pinned dependency fetch failed before creating parser or initrd outputs. Replaced dependency with a task-local SquashFS4 gzip reader checked against all 65 independent prior records.
Initial exploratory read used a virtual data address as a flat file offset and failed bounds. Correct resolution now translates through PT_LOAD; first-segment code addresses are separately rechecked.

network_scope: A public encrypted DNS read and per-request TLS-preserving fallback were researched. The actual successful public format-source fetch receipt records system DNS. No system DNS/proxy/firewall settings were changed; the unsuccessful external parser fetch created no wheel.
source_version_scope: Historical official 2.04/2.05 initrd SD components are byte-identical. Current WBI SKD and CryptoCore snapshot code have separate pinned identities; historical boot SKD is not assumed to be the current snapshot binary.
signature_probe_scope: Public official RSA parameters and original signature bytes only. Twelve changed-byte digest comparisons stay in memory. No full changed package or new signature is emitted.
independent_verification: Host LibreSSL 3.3.6 verifies original 7.02 ciphertext plus IV and rejects IV omission.
signing_parameters: No private RSA parameter read or derivation, no actual ROM/OTP/MMIO access, and no signing function invoked.
